subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this TUI issue be resolved with docs/help for the existing pi-tui newline behavior, or should OpenClaw add a configurable TUI send/newline keybinding contract?
rationale: The central newline insertion path exists through pi-tui, but configurable Enter/Ctrl+Enter/Shift+Enter behavior would add a new public config or CLI surface that repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior First
options.body: Update TUI docs and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Define a narrow TUI keybinding config or CLI surface with default and customized send/newline tests.

options.title: Fold Into Composer Backlog
options.body: Track configurable send keys together with external editor, long-prompt modal, and vi-mode composer work.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update TUI docs and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

likelyOwner.reason: They already framed the remaining docs-versus-config decision on this issue and have the strongest TUI/docs routing signal.
